description: A card that greets a name and counts how many times its button was clicked.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.description: The name to greet. An empty name uses FallbackName.

inputs.name: ButtonLabel
inputs.description: The button's text. Empty falls back to "Greet".

inputs.name: Greeting
inputs.description: The title, with {name} where the name goes. Translate it like any other label.

inputs.name: FallbackName
inputs.description: Used for {name} when Name is empty.

inputs.name: CountLabel
inputs.description: The counter's text, with {count} where the number goes (used for every count but 1).

inputs.name: CountLabelOne
inputs.description: The counter's text for a count of exactly 1; it may use {count} too.

params.name: Count
params.description: How many times the button was clicked.

modifiers.description: Tighter padding and a smaller title.
